title: 2157. Groups of Strings

examples.explanation: - words[0] can be used to obtain words[1] (by replacing 'a' with 'b'), and words[2] (by adding 'b'). So words[0] is connected to words[1] and words[2]. - words[1] can be used to obtain words[0] (by replacing 'b' with 'a'), and words[2] (by adding 'a'). So words[1] is connected to words[0] and words[2]. - words[2] can be used to obtain words[0] (by deleting 'b'), and words[1] (by deleting 'a'). So words[2] is connected to words[0] and words[1]. - words[3] is not connected to any string in words. Thus, words can be divided into 2 groups ["a","b","ab"] and ["cde"]. The size of the largest group is 3.
